narrative.synopsis: Apollo’s Delphic myth begins with a serpent guarding an older power at the sacred site. By killing Python, Apollo claims Delphi and converts the place into his oracle.
narrative.openingSituation: Python holds the ground that will become Apollo’s prophetic center.
narrative.centralConflict: Apollo must displace the serpent before his oracle can be founded.
narrative.resolution: Python is slain by Apollo’s divine weapon.
narrative.outcome: Delphi becomes Apollo’s sanctuary, though the killing still requires ritual memory or purification.

events.consequence: Apollo comes to the serpent’s place.
